title: FulfillmentConfirmation
description: Confirmation details after a payment has been successfully delivered. Contains proof of delivery and transaction details for both source and destination chains.

payment_id.description: Unique identifier for this payment transaction. Use this to track the payment across all systems.

request_id.description: Your original request ID that was provided when creating the payment. Helps match confirmations to your internal systems.

fulfillment_timestamp.description: Timestamp when the fulfillment was completed

source_chain_id.description: The blockchain where funds were locked in escrow, using CAIP-2 format. CAIP-2 is a standard way to identify blockchains: {namespace}:{reference}. Examples: 'eip155:1' for Ethereum mainnet, 'eip155:42161' for Arbitrum, 'solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp' for Solana, 'tron:mainnet' for Tron

destination_chain_id.description: The blockchain where the payment was delivered, using CAIP-2 format. CAIP-2 is a standard way to identify blockchains: {namespace}:{reference}. Examples: 'eip155:1' for Ethereum mainnet, 'eip155:42161' for Arbitrum, 'solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp' for Solana, 'tron:mainnet' for Tron

source_tx_hash.description: Transaction hash of the escrow reservation on the source chain

destination_tx_hash.description: Transaction hash of the fulfillment on the destination chain

source_block_number.description: Block number where the source transaction was confirmed

destination_block_number.description: Block number where the destination transaction was confirmed
